verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms SerpApi serves an llms.txt at serpapi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the product. A second probe confirms per-page markdown docs (search-api.md), and the evidence pack contains several other .md doc pages (markdown-output.md, integrations.md, google-ads-api.md, google-flights-api.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and evidence of how complete llms.txt's coverage is across all APIs.
